name: Power Word Pain

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: One visible creature takes 6d8 Force. If initially at 100 HP or fewer it is also Charmed: Speed capped at 10 feet, Disadvantage on D20 Tests except Constitution saves, and casting requires a successful Constitution save or wastes the action but not the spell slot. Repeat Constitution at each turn end to end the spell.
